stem:
The table shows the weights of four elephants.

Elephant Weights

| Elephant | Weight (pounds) |
|----------|-----------------|
| R        | 12,345          |
| S        | 13,960          |
| T        | 12,509          |
| U        | 11,960          |

Which comparison of these weights is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The weight of Elephant R < the weight of Elephant T

options.label: B
options.text: The weight of Elephant U > the weight of Elephant T

options.label: C
options.text: The weight of Elephant S = the weight of Elephant U

options.label: D
options.text: The weight of Elephant S < the weight of Elephant T

visual_elements: Table of Elephant Weights with columns 'Elephant' and 'Weight (pounds)': R - 12,345; S - 13,960; T - 12,509; U - 11,960
difficulty_rationale: Requires comparing multiple values in a table to evaluate each inequality or equality, involving more than one step of reasoning.
